gloss: one side, one of a pair

definitions.explanation: One item from a matched pair, such as one shoe, one glove, or one earring.
One side in a two-sided situation or relationship.

examples.japanese: {靴下|くつした}の{片方|かたほう}がない。
examples.english: One of my socks is missing.

examples.japanese: {片方|かたほう}の{手|て}で{荷物|にもつ}を{持|も}つ。
examples.english: I hold the luggage with one hand.

examples.japanese: イヤリングの{片方|かたほう}を{落|お}としてしまった。
examples.english: I dropped one of my earrings.

examples.japanese: {片方|かたほう}だけの{話|はなし}を{聞|き}いても{判断|はんだん}できない。
examples.english: You can't judge by hearing only one side of the story.

examples.japanese: けんかでは{片方|かたほう}だけが{悪|わる}いとは{限|かぎ}らない。
examples.english: In a fight, it's not necessarily just one side that's at fault.

examples.japanese: {片方|かたほう}が{賛成|さんせい}しても、もう{片方|かたほう}が{反対|はんたい}することもある。
examples.english: Even if one side agrees, the other side may oppose.

notes:
{片方|かたほう} combines {片|かた} (one of two) + {方|ほう} (direction/side).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {片方|かたほう}の + noun (one of the pair of...)
- {片方|かたほう}だけ (only one side)
- {片方|かたほう}を{失|な}くす (to lose one of a pair)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {片方|かたほう}: one of a pair (general)
- {片|かた}: one (prefix, as in {片手|かたて})
- {一方|いっぽう}: one side; on the other hand
- {両方|りょうほう}: both (antonym)

USAGE NOTES:
- Often used for items that come in pairs: shoes, gloves, earrings, chopsticks
- Can also describe one party in a relationship or dispute
